description: Implement an interactive rating component allowing users to rate a car with 5 stars. Capture hover events, showing label text like 'Poor', 'Fair', 'Good', 'Very Good', and 'Excellent'. Store/show the selected rating gracefully across page interactions.
acceptance_criteria: User can see a 5-star rating visual component on the car card or details page
Hovering over stars dynamically displays a textual string matching the star intensity ('Poor' through 'Excellent')
Clicking a star confirms the selection, rendering a message such as 'Thank you for rating this car!'
Selecting 1 star accurately registers as 'Poor' rating label display
Selecting 5 stars accurately registers as 'Excellent' rating label display
